name: Glenville State University
academic_ranking: Small public university (~1,500 students) founded 1872; known as "West Virginia's only centrally located public university" and the "Lighthouse on the Hill." Average class size of ~15; students from 24 states and 3 countries. No specific national numeric ranking found on official site.
financial_aid: In-state (WV resident) tuition ~$8,666/yr; out-of-state/international ~$10,478/yr (2026-27). Tuition billed by semester. University recommends its Net Price Calculator and Financial Aid office for aid planning. Athletic scholarship details not publicly itemized for softball.
facilities_notes: Softball competes on campus in Glenville, WV; specific softball facility details not published on the reviewed athletics pages.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Mountain East Conference. Detailed public reputation/postseason history not confirmed on reviewed pages.
notes: Data gathered 2026-07 from gstatepioneers.com softball coaches and roster pages plus glenville.edu tuition/about pages. Coaching staff page listed only three softball staff members. Tuition reflects in-state figure; out-of-state ~$10,478.
